title: Damped oscillator
objective: Damped oscillator decay rate and frequency

primary_metric.name: max relative error of period and decay rate
primary_metric.definition: against T_d = 2 pi / sqrt(k/m - (c/2m)^2) and sigma = c / 2m

references: MuJoCo engine tests (passive joint stiffness and damping)
model_assumptions: a mass on a slide joint with linear stiffness and viscous damping, no gravity, no contact; period from upward zero crossings, decay rate from a log-linear fit of the peaks.

variants.task: m 1 kg, k 100 N/m, c 1 N s/m.
m 2 kg, k 50 N/m, c 4 N s/m.
m 0.5 kg, k 200 N/m, c 0.5 N s/m.

grading: referee/criteria.json via oracle.py (stdlib only, run in a separate isolated interpreter)
